whatIs.title: What Is Custom Printed Lanyard Printing?
whatIs.description: A custom printed lanyard is a branded neck strap used to carry an ID card, badge or other identification credential. Instead of using a plain lanyard, organizations can print their logo, name, colours or repeating branding directly onto the lanyard.
whatIs.arrangementNote: The exact attachment depends on the application.

suitableFor.title: 20 mm Custom Printed Lanyards
suitableFor.lede: IDGen offers 20 mm custom printed lanyards for organizational identification requirements. The 20 mm width provides a practical surface for displaying branding while maintaining the lanyard's role as a wearable identification accessory.
suitableFor.footerNote: For application-specific requirements, the appropriate card, holder and attachment configuration should be selected separately.

faqs.q: What is a custom printed lanyard?
faqs.a: A custom printed lanyard is a wearable strap customized with an organization's logo, name, colours, text or artwork and used to carry an ID card or badge.

faqs.q: What size lanyard does IDGen provide?
faqs.a: The standard lanyard featured by IDGen is a 20 mm custom printed lanyard.

faqs.q: Can I print my company logo on the lanyard?
faqs.a: Yes. Organization logos, names, colours, text and approved artwork can be incorporated into the lanyard design.

faqs.q: Can schools order custom printed lanyards?
faqs.a: Yes. Custom lanyards can be used with student and staff identification systems. For the complete student identification solution, see Student ID Card Printing (/student-id-card-printing/).

faqs.q: Can I order lanyards for employees?
faqs.a: Yes. Companies can order branded lanyards for employee and staff identification. See Employee ID Card Printing (/employee-id-card-printing/).

faqs.q: Can I order lanyards for an event?
faqs.a: Yes. Custom printed lanyards can be produced for conferences, seminars, exhibitions and other events. See Event Card Printing (/event-card-printing/).
Yes. You can order custom printed lanyards separately if you already have your ID cards and other accessories.

faqs.q: Can I order lanyards with ID cards?
faqs.a: Yes. Lanyards can be included as part of a broader identification order.
Yes. Ultrasonic sealing can be included for suitable lanyard attachment configurations.

faqs.q: Can I order custom lanyards in bulk?
faqs.a: Yes. Bulk quantities can be quoted according to quantity, artwork and specification.

faqs.q: Can I use my existing design?
faqs.a: Yes. Customer-supplied artwork can be used where it meets the required production specifications.
